name: Marco Masella
bio:
Marco Masella, a masterful lettering tattoo artist based in Benevento, Italy, is known for his precision and skill in creating fluid and impactful typographic designs. Clients frequently praise his professionalism, which is evident in every meticulously crafted piece he inks, ensuring a refined and personalized experience from start to finish at his studio, Akkademy Tattoo in Milan. His dedication to the art form shines through in the sharp lines and elegant flourishes that characterize his sought-after style.
Price: $
Current location: Benevento, Campania, Italy
